content:
B1 sonicgrid-ingest implemented per the approved plan (docs/phases/sonicgrid-ingest.md). Working tree, uncommitted, on 04d9d48 (arbiter commits on request).

Where:
- src/bugalizer/ingest/sonicgrid.py (new): page envelope + per-report models (extra=ignore; reporterEmail is not a field, so it is dropped at the boundary), title/description/reporter/attachment mapping.
- src/bugalizer/ingest/poller.py (new): poll_project (per-project lock per loop, config + generation read under it; forward walk -> re-walk if due/full -> one bookkeeping write), run_tick with in-memory whole-poll backoff min(2^failures,32), start/stop, httpx follow_redirects=False, fixed error vocabulary, token read from os.environ[credential_env] at poll time.
- src/bugalizer/db.py: schema + _migrate (bug_reports.ingest_source/external_id, partial unique index (project_id, external_id), projects.ingest_generation, ingest_state with ON DELETE CASCADE); ingest_commit = one BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction: generation fence -> imports ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING -> checkpoint/bookkeeping update, returns None when fenced; project_update bumps generation + deletes state in the same transaction on an actual ingest change; project_delete deletes state explicitly.
- api/projects.py: GET /projects/{id}/ingest (presence flags only), POST /projects/{id}/ingest/run?full=; main.py: lifespan start/stop, public /health ingest = {enabled, projects, failing} (DB-down safe). models.py/api/reports.py: additive attachments/ingest_source/external_id on reports.
- Docs: .env.example, deploy-windows.md §7c, docs/sonicgrid-ingest-acceptance.md (BOWIE walk), decision_log, roadmap Phase 10, CLAUDE.md.

Plan-approval notes handled: scope item 7 and Risks now say aggregate-only /health; test 6 asserts the forward cursor byte-equal through a behind-checkpoint-only re-walk, with the new-report-mid-rewalk case as a separate test where the forward cursor advances; backoff counts per whole poll (test_forward_success_does_not_reset_repeated_rewalk_failure).

Deviations/settlements, recorded in the plan's new 'Implementation notes': new state row sets last_full_walk_at at creation (first re-walk one interval later, not immediately); a walk ends on null cursor or short page; unmappable reports are skipped + counted, not a poll error; identical PATCH does not reset; added INGEST_PAGE_LIMIT and INGEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS settings.

Verification:
- tests/test_ingest.py: 42 cases against a fake sonicgrid on httpx.MockTransport implementing the contract's composite cursor (criteria 1-13a incl. file-DB restart mid-re-walk, 6 held-response stale cases, deletion, error matrix, secrecy scan of every table/log/response for a planted token and email).
- Plants, each reverted: no generation fence -> 2 fail (the config-change cases; clear/delete are also caught by the null-source/missing-row checks); re-walk writing the forward cursor -> 3 fail; null next_cursor overwriting -> 3 fail; token logged -> 1 fail; follow_redirects=True -> 1 fail.
- One existing test (test_open_pr::test_migration_adds_phase8_columns) exposed that the index needs project_id; index creation now checks both columns exist.
- Full suite: 354 passed @ 04d9d48 + working tree (one run, no gate configured).
- Not verified: anything against real sonicgrid/BOWIE; that is the post-merge acceptance walk (D-C).

Reviewed the implementation against the approved plan, including DB migrations/fencing, cursor/re-walk state, mapping, endpoints, lifecycle and deployment docs. Accepted the lead's recorded full-suite result (354 passed on 04d9d48 + submitted working tree); did not re-run the full suite. Reviewer verification: uv run pytest -q tests/test_ingest.py -> 42 passed; git diff --check clean. Two isolated reproductions expose gaps not covered by those tests.

1. [P1] The documented native-service .env setup fails startup and can expose the poll token in the startup error. .env.example adds SONICGRID_POLL_TOKEN and docs/deploy-windows.md section 7c / acceptance step 1 instruct setting it there, but Settings uses pydantic-settings' default extra=forbid and SONICGRID_POLL_TOKEN is not a settings field. Reproduction with a temporary dotenv file and Settings(_env_file=path) gives location sonicgrid_poll_token, type extra_forbidden; str(ValidationError) contains the dummy token. This happens even with a blank token copied from the new example. Also, pydantic dotenv reading does not populate os.environ, whereas poller.py and the status endpoint read only os.environ. Merely ignoring extra dotenv fields would leave credential_missing on the native path. Make the documented credential-loading path work end-to-end without storing the token in public settings or emitting it on validation failures; alternatively provide a working, explicit process-environment setup for native services and remove the unsupported dotenv instructions/entry. Test startup using a temporary deployment dotenv file, token resolution/status and a mock authorized poll, real-environment precedence, and secret-free startup/error output. Do not rely on incidental dotenv loading by an imported library.

2. [P2] Malformed attachment URLs abort the entire tick and starve later projects. sonicgrid.py:96 calls urlsplit outside the ValidationError handler; url='https://[broken' raises ValueError. poll_project catches only _Stale, and run_tick's await at poller.py:320 has no per-project exception boundary. Reproduction with bad project first and good project second: run_tick raises ValueError, only bad.test is requested, neither project has an ingest state/error recorded. The background loop catches this outside the project iteration and retries the same poison page every tick without project backoff; manual run returns 500. Drop invalid attachment URLs at the mapping boundary, and contain unexpected per-project failures so a failed project's bookkeeping/backoff uses a fixed secret-free error and the next project still runs (preserve cancellation and generation fencing). Add a malformed-URL page test plus a bad-first/good-second test; the existing isolation test puts the healthy project first and only exercises credential_missing.

D-A/D-B/D-C remain respected; real Sonicgrid/BOWIE acceptance is still correctly pending post-merge. The documented initial reconciliation scheduling and short-page completion adjustments are acceptable.

r2 fixes both r1 findings. Still uncommitted on 04d9d48.

P1 (.env credential): reproduced (Settings(_env_file=...) -> extra_forbidden, token in the error). Fix:
- config.py: Settings extra='ignore'; new resolve_env_credential(name): real process env wins, else the deployment .env (BUGALIZER_ENV_FILE rule, default .env) read fresh per use with python-dotenv dotenv_values; never cached, never copied into Settings or os.environ; blank = None. unknown_env_file_settings() lists typo'd BUGALIZER_* keys by name only; main.py lifespan logs them as a warning (replaces the fail-loud forbid gave).
- poller.py and GET /projects/{id}/ingest use the resolver. python-dotenv declared in pyproject (was transitive via pydantic-settings); uv.lock +2 lines.
- Tests: in-process .env load + resolution + status + authorized mock poll with the token absent from os.environ; blank .env token -> loads, credential_missing, no request; real env precedence; Settings error with a bad field + .env token is secret-free; unknown-key names; and test_native_startup_with_deployment_dotenv: a fresh subprocess with a clean environment and only BUGALIZER_ENV_FILE set (DB path, queue flag and token all in the file) starts the app lifespan, credential_present true, authorized mock poll imports 1, SONICGRID_POLL_TOKEN not in the child's os.environ, token absent from stdout/stderr, startup warning names the typo key.
- Docs: .env.example, deploy-windows.md 7c, plan implementation notes.

P2 (poison page): reproduced mapping path. Fix:
- sonicgrid.py: urlsplit/hostname inside try, invalid URL dropped.
- poller.py: poll_project catches Exception (not BaseException, so cancellation propagates) after _Stale: logs type name only, records fixed internal_error via _finish through the generation fence (so backoff applies; a fenced write still yields config_changed); run_tick has a second per-project boundary. Manual run returns 200 with last_error internal_error.
- Tests: malformed URL mapping unit; bad-first/good-second tick with a https://[broken attachment (both import); bad-first/good-second with an injected mapping exception carrying the token (good still imports, bad: internal_error, failures 1, cursor not advanced, skip 2, no token or exception text in logs, manual run 200). Crash-safety test updated: the mid-page failure now records internal_error instead of raising; rows and cursor still unchanged, replay imports each once.

Plants (each reverted): extra forbid -> 3 fail; poller reading os.environ only -> 2 fail; no urlsplit guard -> 2 fail; no per-project boundary -> 2 fail.

Full suite: 363 passed @ 04d9d48 + working tree (one run); git diff --check clean. Real sonicgrid/BOWIE still pending post-merge (D-C).

Approved. Both round 1 findings are resolved. Credential lookup now supports the documented deployment dotenv file without adding the token to Settings or os.environ, honors real-environment precedence, and is shared by polling and status. The fresh-process startup regression verifies credential presence and an authorized mock import with secret-free output. Invalid attachment URLs are dropped, unexpected poll failures record a fixed internal_error through the generation fence, and the per-project boundaries allow later projects to run while cancellation still propagates.

Reviewer verification: uv run pytest -q tests/test_ingest.py -> 51 passed (including the new dotenv/startup and bad-first/good-second regressions); git diff --check clean. Reviewed the config, endpoint, poller, mapping, dependency/lockfile and documentation changes. Accepted the lead's recorded full-suite result of 363 passed on 04d9d48 plus the submitted working tree; did not rerun the full suite. No remaining blocking findings.

D-A/D-B/D-C remain respected. This approves the implementation; real Sonicgrid/BOWIE acceptance remains pending post-merge per docs/sonicgrid-ingest-acceptance.md. No commit, push, merge or deployment performed in this review.
